title: fig05 transfer-entropy LFP-LFP network also null -- all three attempted connectivity methods now agree, fig05 main-figure slot needs a non-connectivity pivot
notes: Third and final connectivity method attempted for fig05's LFP-LFP slot: transfer entropy, via new scripts/compute_lfp_lfp_te_network.py (n_surrogates=15, a disclosed runtime-vs-validity compromise from the estimator's default 200) and scripts/aggregate_lfp_lfp_te_stats.py (reuses fig05_lfp_lfp_coupling.py's net_directionality/within_condition_stats/delta_stats functions directly rather than reimplementing the aggregation, keeping the two methods' group-level tests exactly comparable).

Extraction: 22 sessions, 3100 edge rows, 88 min runtime (faster than the multi-hour worst case estimated before launch). Aggregation: 0/150 tests survive Holm-Bonferroni across the same three families as Granger (fig05_te_RXRR, fig05_te_RRRR, fig05_te_delta).

RESULT: all three LFP-LFP connectivity methods on this corpus now agree -- null at the group level. Imaginary coherency 0/240 (2026-07-30 original build), directed Granger causality 0/150 (2026-08-04), transfer entropy 0/150 (2026-08-04/05). This is a real, three-times-replicated negative result across three genuinely different statistical questions (symmetric synchronization, linear directed prediction, nonlinear directed information flow), not a single underpowered attempt.

Per feedback_figures_require_significance memory, fig05's main-figure slot cannot be a null connectivity result. All three analyses are preserved as real supplement content (supp_lfp_lfp_coherency.py for coherency; fig05_lfp_lfp_coupling.py's own Granger network get relabeled supplement if the pivot proceeds; fig05_te_stats.md for TE) -- the negative result itself is informative and should stay documented, not deleted.

Recommended next step (stated, not yet executed): pivot fig05's headline to the already-significant, already-replicated V3a/d beta elevation vs V1 (CLAUDE.md's omission-a status: +1.11dB, replicated on 17- and 23-session corpora). Awaiting explicit user confirmation before rebuilding fig05 around this instead of connectivity.
